identities.label: Nuxalk
identities.description: Salishan ethnic group of British Columbia, Canada
identities.summary: The Nuxalk people (Nuxalk: Nuxalkmc; pronounced [ʔnuχalcmç]), also referred to as the Bella Coola, Bellacoola or Bilchula, are a First Nation of the Pacific Northwest Coast, centred in the area in and around Bella Coola, British Columbia within their wider traditional territory: Kulhulmcilh.  They speak the Nuxalk language (Nuxalk: It7Nuxalkmc). Their on-reserve tribal government is the Nuxalk Nation.
